newsitem.title: UK: Roxboro drops as TT Group sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Roxboro drops as TT Group sells stake.

text.p: Roxboro Group Plc dropped in heavy trade on Friday as TT Group Plc sold its eight percent stake in the specialist components and instruments maker, market sources said.
The stock was down 3-1/2p at 187-1/2 by 1211 GMT in volume of 9.1 million shares.
TT bought a stake of 4.7 million shares last November, days after a profit warning from Roxboro sparked a sharp decline in its shares, but it has already reduced its holding.

Roxboro said on November 8 that profits for the year would be below expectations and said it saw no immediate prospect of a meaningful recovery in demand levels at its Dialight Electronics Product Group.
However the stock has rallied since TT took its stake giving TT an opportunity to cash in gains.
No-one at either company was immediately available for comment.
